title: Rotate Matrix 90 Degrees
description:
You are given an n x n 2D matrix representing an image. Rotate the matrix by 90 degrees (clockwise).
Print the rotated matrix row by row with space-separated values.
input_format:
Line 1: An integer n.
Next n lines: n space-separated integers per row.
output_format: Print the rotated matrix of size n x n.
